isolation.detail: Both pinned provider CLIs completed authenticated calls inside agent-eval-foundry/provider-agent:claude-2.1.260-codex-0.152.1. Provider containers use bridge networking only for vendor APIs, a read-only root, dropped capabilities, uid 1000, resource limits, a writable per-attempt workspace with a nested read-only challenge, and exactly one provider-specific credential channel. Submitted modules are re-run separately in fresh no-network containers before host-owned verification.
